d: While addressing the Indian community in Tokyo, Japan, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said, 'You will be pleased to know that today, India is exporting weapons and various other defense items worth Rs 40,000 crore. Before our government took office, defence production has now grown to over 1,80,000 crore. As for our nation’s armed forces—the Army, the Navy, and the Air Force—you may have witnessed the remarkable feats they have achieved, such as in 'Operation Sindoor.''
